description_en: Modifies the properties of a scheduled O&M event. Currently, you can modify the planned execute time of a scheduled O&M event
description_zh: 修改计划内运维事件属性，目前支持修改计划内运维事件的计划执行时间
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-system-event-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --event-id e-2zeielxl1qzq8slb0000 --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --not-before 2026-06-30T00:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySystemEventAttribute

parameters.description_en: The new planned execution time of the system event. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/iso-8601-time-format) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: 新的系统事件计划执行时间。按照[ISO 8601](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/iso-8601-time-format)标准表示，并需要使用 UTC +0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
parameters.help_en: The new planned execution time of the system event. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/iso-8601-time-format) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
